title: Zyppy™ Plasmid Miniprep Kit
author: Zymo Research
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gi3bugn

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Prepare the bacterial culture for plasmid extraction using one of two methods.

substeps.instruction: Method 1: Add 600 μl of bacterial culture grown in LB medium to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.

Method 2 (for up to 3 ml culture): Centrifuge 1.5 ml of bacterial culture for 30 seconds at maximum speed, discard the supernatant, and repeat as needed. Add 600 μl of TE or water to the bacterial cell pellet and resuspend completely.

steps.title: Lyse Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse the cells using 7X Lysis Buffer (Blue).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μl of 7X Lysis Buffer (Blue) and mix by inverting the tube 4-6 times.
Ensure the solution changes from opaque to clear blue.
Proceed to the neutralization step within 2 minutes to avoid denaturing plasmid DNA.

steps.title: Neutralize the Sample
steps.instruction: Neutralize the lysed cells to precipitate DNA and proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μl of cold Neutralization Buffer (Yellow) and mix thoroughly until the sample turns yellow and a yellowish precipitate forms.
Invert the sample an additional 2-3 times to ensure complete neutralization.

steps.title: Clear Cell Debris
steps.instruction: Separate the plasmid DNA from the cell debris via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 11,000 – 16,000 x g for 2-4 minutes.

steps.title: Bind DNA to Column
steps.instruction: Load the supernatant onto the Zymo-Spin™ IIN column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant (~900 μl) into the provided Zymo-Spin™ IIN column, avoiding the cell debris pellet.
Place the column into a Collection Tube and centrifuge for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Wash the Column
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Discard the flow-through and place the column back into the same Collection Tube.
Add 200 μl of Endo-Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 30 seconds.
Add 400 μl of Zyppy™ Wash Buffer to the column and centrifuge for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified plasmid DNA from the column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the column into a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 30 μl of Zyppy™ Elution Buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl, pH 8.5 and 0.1 mM EDTA) or pure water (neutral pH) directly to the column matrix.
Let stand for one minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge for 30 seconds to elute the plasmid DNA.
